lede: Louisiana carries the stronger underlying team rating — -4.9 against -10.7, a 5.8-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Charlotte +6.0 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Louisiana winning 66% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is scheme fit, where Charlotte leads Louisiana by 84 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 83% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
